notes: Derived from the recorded baseline of legal_retrieval_v2 at 155 rows (commit 9c9512a55cbeea98c683d6f400892b703eeaa61d): two identical deterministic offline runs measured recall@10=0.5774193548387097, MRR=0.3888863287250384, nDCG@10=0.4304632615580462 (see baseline_legal_retrieval_v2_wave4.json and .run2.json; the full per-branch attribution is in the reports). Thresholds sit just below the measured values (round-down to two decimals) so cross-platform float noise cannot flake the gate while any real regression fails. A threshold change must re-run the harness and cite a new report.
